title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook - 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out Wall Mount Brass Hook, 15 Lb Capacity, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your bathroom wall—this retractable hook pulls out when you need it and slides back in when you don’t. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a smart fit for modern bathroom hardware and minimalist bathroom fixtures.

  • Create instant hanging space: the rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then retracts out of the way.
  • Hang with confidence: supports up to 15 lb for robes, towels, and everyday essentials.
  • Match your bathroom hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob.
  • Designed for standard walls: fits standard interior walls and mounts cleanly in a modern, architectural look.
  • Everything needed to install: all mounting hardware included with toggle bolts.

Why it stands out: Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives.

Specs

  • Product type: retractable wall hook
  • Material: brass
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Pull-out hanging space: 2-1/2"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 2" x 2" x 3.75"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Installation notes: requires drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and three small holes around; uses 6/32 toggles
  • Warranty: lifetime warranty
